name: Research & Development & Life Sciences LIMS Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for R&D and Life Sciences Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), covering idea management, lab notebook records (ELN), specimen sample tracking, study protocols, IP patent disclosures, and technology transfer commercialization.
owner: Global R&D & Life Sciences Innovation Office

checklists.name: Research & Life Sciences LIMS Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ELN lab notebooks, specimen sample tracking, invention disclosures, and IP filings.

items.statement: Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) entries are timestamped and signed off by a witnessing researcher.
LIMS sample tracking maintains chain-of-custody barcode logs for all biological and chemical specimens.
Laboratory instruments (mass spectrometers, PCR machines) undergo periodic calibration verification.
Invention disclosures are submitted to IP Legal Counsel prior to public publication or conference presentations.
Technology transfer agreements specify royalty terms and commercialization milestone schedules.

reviewGates.name: Head of R&D Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of R&D and Chief Patent Counsel confirm that ELN records, LIMS sample tracking, and IP disclosures satisfy research integrity standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the R&D documentation confirm lab data integrity and patent protection clearance?
